name: CVF Engineering Test Evidence Audit
purpose: Give an advisory KEEP/REPAIR/CONSOLIDATE/ADD/DEFER_WITH_REASON disposition for one asserted existing-proof claim tied to a named source file and a named test file, by reading the actual test assertions rather than trusting the claim sentence or a docstring.
useWhen: A worker or reviewer holds an asserted existing-proof claim (a comment, commit message, docstring, or prior review stating a source file is tested or covered) tied to a specific source file and a specific test file or test function, and needs an advisory KEEP/REPAIR/CONSOLIDATE/ADD/DEFER_WITH_REASON disposition before trusting or extending that claim.
doNotUseWhen: Do not use to author a new failing test before implementation exists (that is TDD's red-green-refactor trigger, a distinct task class). Do not use to review a diff or PR for correctness/simplification/efficiency defects in changed code (that is code-review's trigger). Do not use as a substitute for running the named test; this candidate does not execute, evaluate, or delete any test.
riskTriggers: advisory label mistaken for a test PASS or deletion permission
named test file absent or not actually referencing the claimed source symbol
read authority over a file mistaken for execution authority
inputs: the named test file path (or an explicit statement that no test file is known, which forces DEFER_WITH_REASON)
outputs: one advisory artifact row: target, label, cited evidence, reason, confidence/unknowns, next owner/action
no test PASS, no deletion permission, no runtime receipt
executionConstraints: advisory only; loading or reading this metadata, the package body, or the accepted content source never authorizes running the named test, fixture creation, or any Git mutation; a KEEP/REPAIR/CONSOLIDATE/ADD/DEFER_WITH_REASON label is a recommendation attached to a target, evidence, and reason, never a test result
acceptanceEvidence: docs/reviews/CVF_CVF_NCR_R1_S02_TEST_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_CONTENT_COMPLETION_2026-09-27.md (content accepted; worker's prohibited fixture/pytest execution recorded as a disclosed scope violation and explicitly excluded from acceptance evidence); docs/reviews/CVF_CVF_NCR_R1_S04_TEST_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_METADATA_CANDIDATE_COMPLETION_2026-09-27.md (P3 metadata accepted with recorded worker scope violation for an unauthorized Git-mutation diagnostic, also excluded from acceptance evidence); docs/reviews/CVF_CVF_NCR_R1_S06_TEST_EVIDENCE_AUDIT_UAT_CERTIFICATION_2026-09-27.md (P5 five-case source-based UAT, all PASS, no audited test execution)
authorityCeiling: bounded advisory content guidance only; a label never mutates a test result, a checker verdict, or a file, and never authorizes deleting or skipping a test
sideEffects: none from metadata or package-body loading; the compressed instruction body itself performs no execution; any future approval, UAT, certification, truth, or evaluation requires separate authorization
permissions: read the named source file, the named test file, and any directly imported helper module the assertion depends on; no repository-wide read is claimed
rollback: restore this registry entry and package root to their pre-P4 PROPOSED-absent state, remove the P6 truth packet at docs/reference/agent_system_skills/truth/packets/cvf-engineering-test-evidence-audit.json, and regenerate all canonical projections
safeStop: if the named test file is absent or does not reference the named source symbol, stop at DEFER_WITH_REASON with a no-match reason rather than substituting a different file
capabilityBoundary: P10 ACTIVE production package runtime for one bounded advisory package. Internal and external CLI/MCP body use require the existing receipt-backed production executor under separate work-order authority. Loading alone grants no test execution, filesystem, Git, browser, provider, public-sync, deployment, or downstream action authority.
resolverBehavior: metadata-only; resolver returns identity and selector fields only; opening the package body still requires an explicit, separately authorized selection under active governed work-order authority
loaderBoundary: loading this metadata or the package body never grants authority to commit, activate, execute a test, delete a test, or expand any active work order
externalMutationBoundary: receipt-backed external readout and advisory output only; no audited-test execution, file mutation, deletion permission, downstream action, retry, public sync, or deployment authority follows from the adapter
platformCompatibility: cross-platform metadata; package body is prose-only and platform-neutral
shellAssumptions: no shell execution required or authorized for this contract-only PROPOSED package
